purpose: Machine-readable component, function, specification, dependency and verification inventory

systems.name: ATCLang
systems.mission: Native language frontend, syntax, AST and compilation boundary for the A-TownChain execution ecosystem

functions.name: Lexical analysis
functions.specification: Tokenize source and report invalid tokens with source locations

functions.name: Parsing and AST construction
functions.specification: Parse the versioned grammar and construct the AST
acceptance: Valid and invalid grammar cases are tested

functions.name: Directive and declaration processing
functions.specification: Process supported native directives and declarations without duplicating VM execution
acceptance: No competing production VM is introduced

functions.name: Diagnostics
functions.specification: Emit stable, actionable frontend diagnostics
acceptance: Source spans are included where available

functions.name: Canonical bytecode target
functions.specification: Define and validate the frontend boundary to canonical ATCB bytecode
acceptance: Output conforms to the normative bytecode format
Version and instruction count are validated

systems.name: ATC-VM
systems.mission: Canonical deterministic virtual machine implementation for ATC bytecode

functions.name: Bytecode decoding and validation
functions.specification: Validate header, version, instruction count and instruction encoding before execution
acceptance: Malformed and truncated bytecode is rejected

functions.name: Deterministic execution
functions.specification: Execute supported instructions with deterministic state transitions
acceptance: Equivalent input state and bytecode produce equivalent results

functions.name: Operand stack bounds
functions.specification: Enforce maximum operand stack depth

functions.name: Program instruction bounds
functions.specification: Enforce maximum instruction count
acceptance: Programs above the limit are rejected

functions.name: Storage bounds
functions.specification: Enforce storage slot limits and deterministic storage semantics

functions.name: Gas or execution-cost accounting
functions.specification: Define and enforce deterministic execution costs
acceptance: Every executable opcode has defined cost semantics

functions.name: Execution results and errors
functions.specification: Return deterministic results or structured execution failures
acceptance: Failed execution is never reported as success
State commit and rollback semantics are specified

format_conflicts: Resolve ATCB versus ATC1 references against normative specification

prohibited_responsibilities: Maintaining a competing canonical VM in another repository

systems.name: ATC-Algorithm
systems.mission: Canonical consensus and algorithm implementation for A-TownChain

functions.name: Consensus rule evaluation
functions.specification: Evaluate candidate blocks and state transitions against normative consensus rules

functions.name: Block and protocol validation
functions.specification: Validate algorithm-owned structural and protocol requirements
acceptance: Responsibilities are not duplicated across layers

functions.name: Fork choice and chain selection
functions.specification: Apply the normative chain-selection and tie-breaking rules
acceptance: Reorganizations and adversarial cases are tested

functions.name: Consensus parameter validation
functions.specification: Validate parameters against active protocol version
acceptance: Runtime configuration cannot silently change consensus

functions.name: Consensus test vectors
functions.specification: Maintain versioned positive, negative and boundary vectors

specifications.standalone_repository_role: specifications/governance/support only; verify actual repository state

prohibited_responsibilities: Changing monetary/finality parameters outside protocol governance

systems.name: ShivaCore Kernel
systems.mission: Rust no_std capability-based microkernel and minimal trusted computing base

functions.name: Capability enforcement
functions.specification: Require explicit authority for kernel-managed objects and resources
acceptance: Capability lifecycle and revocation are specified

functions.name: Process and address-space isolation
functions.specification: Isolate execution contexts and enforce memory permissions

functions.name: Virtual memory management
functions.specification: Manage page tables, mutation rollback, unmapping and mapping lifetime
acceptance: Unmap and table reclamation preserve invariants

functions.name: IPC and event delivery
functions.specification: Provide controlled IPC and defined event semantics
acceptance: Sender and receiver permissions are enforced

functions.name: Scheduling and process lifecycle
functions.specification: Manage process state transitions and scheduling

functions.name: Interrupt, timer and HAL
functions.specification: Provide minimal controlled architecture-specific hardware interfaces

functions.name: Boot and platform trust
functions.specification: Define verifiable boot chain and platform trust-provider interfaces
acceptance: Boot artifacts and assumptions are documented
Secure Boot evidence exists for declared targets

prohibited_responsibilities: Hosting Aurora AI decision logic in kernel
Embedding ordinary network stacks in kernel core

systems.name: A-TownChain
systems.mission: Canonical blockchain core integrating transactions, blocks, ledger state, consensus and execution

functions.name: Transaction encoding and validation
functions.specification: Validate canonical transaction encoding, signatures, signing domains and field constraints
acceptance: Legacy domains are not silently accepted

functions.name: Block validation and state transition
functions.specification: Validate blocks and apply protocol-defined state transitions atomically

functions.name: Ledger and account state
functions.specification: Maintain canonical balances, nonces and protocol state using exact arithmetic

functions.name: Block production integration
functions.specification: Integrate consensus, transaction validation and execution
acceptance: Production and validation use the same rules

functions.name: Canonical VM integration
functions.specification: Invoke the canonical VM through a versioned execution interface

functions.name: Protocol parameters and upgrades
functions.specification: Enforce versioned monetary, timing and protocol parameters

prohibited_responsibilities: Using floating point for consensus-critical amounts
Changing consensus parameters without versioned governance

systems.name: GlobusOS
systems.mission: Operating-system integration and service platform built around ShivaCore

functions.name: Boot and kernel handoff
functions.specification: Initialize platform and transfer control to canonical ShivaCore kernel

functions.name: Service lifecycle management
functions.specification: Start, supervise, isolate and stop user-space services under explicit authority
acceptance: Service identities and permissions are explicit

functions.name: Networking service integration
functions.specification: Provide networking in service space rather than expanding kernel TCB
acceptance: IPC and capability boundaries are enforced

functions.name: ATC service integration
functions.specification: Integrate node, VM, wallet and blockchain services through explicit interfaces
acceptance: Blockchain is not a kernel responsibility

functions.name: Aurora AI service integration
functions.specification: Host AI runtime and policy-mediated tools outside ShivaCore TCB
acceptance: AI has no implicit kernel authority
Actions pass policy and capability checks

functions.name: Hardware abstraction
functions.specification: Define interfaces for supported CPU, memory, timer, interrupt and device capabilities

prohibited_responsibilities: Moving ordinary networking/blockchain services into TCB

systems.name: Genesis Engine
systems.mission: Governed genesis configuration, deterministic artifact generation and initial-chain validation

functions.name: Genesis specification ingestion
functions.specification: Load and validate versioned genesis manifest against normative schema

functions.name: Genesis artifact generation
functions.specification: Generate canonical genesis artifacts from validated configuration

functions.name: Initial allocation validation
functions.specification: Validate initial balances, allocations and supply invariants

functions.name: Genesis hash and reproducibility
functions.specification: Compute and independently verify genesis identifiers and hashes
acceptance: Serialization and hash inputs are normative

functions.name: Node acceptance validation
functions.specification: Verify artifacts using canonical A-TownChain validation logic

functions.name: Release provenance
functions.specification: Record source SHA, configuration digest, tool versions and output evidence
acceptance: Logs and test evidence are retained
Unverified outputs are not marked VERIFIED

cross_system_requirements.name: Canonical ownership
cross_system_requirements.requirement: Each production implementation has exactly one canonical repository
cross_system_requirements.acceptance: No active competing implementation exists for the same canonical component

cross_system_requirements.name: Versioned interfaces
cross_system_requirements.requirement: Cross-component interfaces and binary formats are versioned and testable
cross_system_requirements.acceptance: Compatibility and rejection behavior are covered by tests

cross_system_requirements.name: Exact-SHA evidence
cross_system_requirements.requirement: Verification refers to exact tested commit SHA
cross_system_requirements.acceptance: Evidence records workflow run, job, step, exit code and relevant log or artifact

cross_system_requirements.name: Fail-closed validation
cross_system_requirements.requirement: Malformed input, missing authority and unsupported versions fail explicitly

cross_system_requirements.name: Status integrity
cross_system_requirements.requirement: Implementation and verification are not inferred from file presence or PR merge state
cross_system_requirements.acceptance: VERIFIED requires defined technical gates and exact-SHA evidence

cross_system_requirements.name: Dependency integrity
cross_system_requirements.requirement: Dependencies are explicit and conflicts are tracked
cross_system_requirements.acceptance: Integration tests cover declared cross-component contracts

audit_requirements: Confirm repository names, canonical paths, default branches and current SHAs
Compare catalog entries with current default-branch source
Collect public APIs, modules, types, commands, formats and tests
Link each specification to normative document and version
Link each implemented function to source paths and tests
Record exact SHA and CI Run-to-Job-to-Step evidence
Resolve duplicate ownership, specification conflicts and missing dependencies
Do not promote AUDIT_REQUIRED or PROPOSED to VERIFIED without evidence
